**Share from "Others": ≈ 84.3%**

Details (change from week ended Jul 30, 2025, averages of daily figures):
- Total reverse repurchase agreements: **–181,761** million
- Foreign official and international accounts: –28,523 million
- Others: **–153,238** million

153,238 / 181,761 ≈ 0.843, so about 84.3% of the year-over-year decline in total reverse repurchase agreements came from the "Others" category, while the remaining ~15.7% came from foreign official and international accounts.
